algorithms.own: generic byte runs: fixed comparison block and maximum unchanged-byte merge gap; no record/schema/game assumption
algorithms.qbsdiff-small: compression level 1, no parallel search, decoder buffer4096/delta128; default variant unchanged
algorithms.bidiff-single: one suffix-sort partition; default variant unchanged
algorithms.lz4: same optional lz4_flex size-prefixed block wrapper around every control/own/upstream delta and full path

normal_dependencies: none; upstream libraries and lz4 only optional comparison feature

component.scope: actual encode/decode and complete byte equality; not a replication engine or live-client capacity comparison

proofs: random variable-length exact models every codec
same baseline full ownership and tracked cache/session semantics through Sender
20k actual receiver reconstruction for initial upstream admissions

replication_initial.scope: encoding adapters inside the same Rill replication kernel; NOT independent full upstream replication engines

acceptance: All losses and failures retained. No winner from component or parallel timings. Full upstream replication-engine adapters, broader payload/trace/peer/memory coverage, source closure, serial paired statistics and untouched holdouts remain required.
